==Ingredients==
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] fancy [[Cookbook:Molasses|molasses]]
*1 ½ cups granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*1 ½ [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]]
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Cream of Tartar|cream of tartar]] 
*4 Tbsp [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*⅛ tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]

==Procedure==

#Combine molasses, sugar, vinegar and water in a heavy [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] over medium heat.
#[[Cookbook:Cooking Sugar|Cook]] to 255–270°F (124–132°C). The hotter the [[Cookbook:Syrup|syrup]], the harder the final taffy will be.
#Remove from heat and stir in butter, cream of tartar, and baking soda.
#Pour into buttered pan or onto marble surface, and let cool slightly.
#When cool and thick enough to handle, grease your hands. Grab the candy mixture with both hands, and stretch it apart while twisting slightly. Repeat this process, pulling and twisting the candy until light in color. This pulling and twisting process incorporates air and lightens the candy.
#Cut into 1-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] pieces; wrap in squares of waxed paper.

steps.text: Combine molasses, sugar, vinegar and water in a heavy saucepan over medium heat.
Cook to 255–270°F (124–132°C). The hotter the syrup, the harder the final taffy will be.
Remove from heat and stir in butter, cream of tartar, and baking soda.
Pour into buttered pan or onto marble surface, and let cool slightly.

When cool and thick enough to handle, grease your hands. Grab the candy mixture with both hands, and stretch it apart while twisting slightly. Repeat this process, pulling and twisting the candy until light in color. This pulling and twisting process incorporates air and lightens the candy.
Cut into 1-inch pieces; wrap in squares of waxed paper.
